# SK4006 — Review a materialization used only by foreach

<!-- Generated from Rules/Rikarin.Skala.Rules.Metadata/rules.json. Do not edit. -->

A framework ToList or ToArray temporary over a stable local or parameter is consumed directly by foreach.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | Performance |
| Default severity | hint |
| Scope | Semantic |
| Needs a compilation | yes |
| Fix | no |
| Language version floor | — |
| Since | 1.3 |

## Why

The temporary collection is not retained or indexed; it is used only to enumerate once. Removing it may save work, but can also remove an intentional snapshot and change exception timing or interactions with mutations. The rule therefore offers a review hint without an automatic fix.

## Example

Instead of:

```csharp
foreach (var item in values.ToArray()) { Consume(item); }
```

Write:

```csharp
foreach (var item in values) { Consume(item); } // only when snapshot and timing differences are acceptable
```

## When it does not fire

Only framework Enumerable.ToList/ToArray directly feeding synchronous foreach over an uncaptured, non-ref local or parameter are reported. Parentheses and static-call spelling are accepted. Query pipelines, fields, factory expressions, custom materializers, retained temporaries, awaits and yields are excluded. Any reference to the source symbol inside the loop body suppresses the hint, preserving obvious mutation/snapshot patterns including the SK2007 fix. Hidden mutation through called methods and intentional eager evaluation cannot be proved away; retain or suppress the hint when a snapshot is required.

## Configuration

- `dotnet_diagnostic.SK4006.severity`
